answer: Proof-of-Stake remains the most robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By requiring capital commitment, it forces an attacker to purchase governance tokens, creating a financial river of irreversible costs that scales linearly with influence. Much like a juniper tree takes deep root against erosion, this mechanism ensures that any attempt to spawn a plume of fake identities incurs massive capital depreciation. The attacker pays for every malicious node created, rendering mass identity fraud economically terminal.
